ns2:section.sectionText: Field Geology: Structure and tectonics of the southwestern United States. The course consists of a required ~8-day field trip to western Arizona and southern California during Spring Break, and a series of pre-trip lectures addressing the regional tectonic evolution of the North American Cordillera. Field study focuses on the Basin and Range Rift, the San Andreas Fault, and Death Valley. Participants will be camping in isolated desert locations, with no facilities, during the trip. Class meeting schedule: Tuesday (5:00 - 6:30 p.m.) Estimated Cost: $800 per student. The course is intended primarily for geology majors and graduate students. Prerequisites: Junior, Senior, or Graduate status, at least one Geology course, or permission of the instructor. 4 hrs.
